interface.name: zsingularity_key_hold_manager_v1
interface.description: Lets the desktop shell know when the Super key is held down on its own for longer than a delay, so it can show a shortcuts overview. While a hold is active the compositor does not run keybinds for other keys and forwards them to the focused surface instead, and the release of the held key does not trigger its release keybind.

request.name: set_delay
request.description: Sets how long the key must stay down alone, in milliseconds, before the hold starts. Zero disables holds for this client. The default is zero, so a client must opt in.

request.name: finish
request.description: Ends the active hold without waiting for the key release, so the compositor runs keybinds again. The release of the key still does not run its release keybind.

description.summary: the key has been held alone past the delay

event.name: hold_end
event.description: Sent when the held key is released, or with reason cancelled when the compositor gave up the hold, for example because the session locked.
